Name: Pierre's Seeds Overhaul
Author: Alxx15
Description:
[size=3]Tired of waiting on the first day of a season to buy seeds ? Bothered by not buying enough seeds for multi-season crops ? Fazed about the low selection of seeds at Pierre's ?[/size]

[i][size=4]Oh, do I have a mod for you ![/size][size=3]

[/size][/i][size=3]This mod gives you the FULL CONTROL over Pierre's seed inventory.


[/size][size=5]Features
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Choose on which day of the season each seed becomes available for purchase at Pierre's[/size]
[*][size=3]Choose the year on which each seed becomes available for purchase at Pierre's[/size]
[*][size=3]Choose the price ![/size]
[/list]

[size=3]Default settings are as follow:
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Seeds are available to purchase on the season they can grow (e.g. Corn Seeds can be purchased in the summer and in the fall)[/size]
[*][size=3]Seeds become available to purchase on the 26th of the previous season they can grow (e.g. Amaranth Seeds can be purchased starting from the 26th day of summer until 28th day of fall)[/size]
[*][size=3]Prices are generally unchanged[/size]
[*][size=3]Special seeds (Rare, Ancient, Cactus, Mixed, Taro Tuber, Pineapple, Fiber, Qi Bean and Mixed Flowers) are left unchanged - but are available in the mod's configs ![/size]
[*][size=3]All non-special seeds are available from the first year.[/size]

[/list][size=5]
Instructions[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size][size=3].[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher.[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][i]Optional [/i]but recommended : Install the latest version of[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b] Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Configurations
[/size][b]
[size=3]Best used with[/size][/b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b] Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url]

In this mod's [i]config.json[/i] file you will find options to enable or disable the patching, on [size=3]which day of each season the seed becomes available, the year, and the price, for [i][u]each seed individuall[/u][/i]y !

Please note that edits to the configurations during gameplay will only be applied the next day/next reload of save.
[/size][/size]
